unknowns.question: Does the six-mechanism core improve capability when hidden targets and latent parameters are inaccessible to candidate modules?
unknowns.falsification_test: Run leak-resistant held-out benchmark with observable-only inputs and independent oracle.

unknowns.question: Does representation reuse produce positive transfer to unseen task families at equal compute?
unknowns.falsification_test: Compare A-to-B transfer against no-transfer baseline on unseen domains with identical budgets.

unknowns.question: Does failure learning improve future performance rather than memorize target-derived corrections?
unknowns.falsification_test: Expose verified failures on training families, then evaluate on fresh structurally related and unrelated tasks without target access.

unknowns.question: Can procedure refinement produce A1 > A0 across multiple held-out domains with equal resources and no human selection after preregistration?
unknowns.falsification_test: Blind A/B comparison of frozen A0 and machine-proposed A1 on withheld generators.

unknowns.question: Is the apparent architecture gain larger than gains obtainable by equivalent extra compute, retries, context, memory or search?
unknowns.falsification_test: Matched-resource baseline plus compute-scaling control curve.
